Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a '''war''' occurred on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] between [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and [[Wizard of the Night Spirit|Wizards of the Night Spirit]]. With the power of the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]], the Ewoks banished the Wizards to the "[[Unidentified world (Stranger)|otherworld]]."
